verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's core product includes self-serve funnels ('measure conversions through a series of events') and retention reports designed for exactly this use case, plus session replay to explore 'why customers drop off' and dashboards to 'discover critical drop-off points' — all built for non-analysts via UI, no code required. Community evidence corroborates that Mixpanel's whole value prop is making analytics accessible to non-engineers/founders. Missing for 10: no independent case study of a founder specifically self-serving a funnel diagnosis without help, and some community comments note ease-of-use/pricing friction.
